conventions.stats: [health, followRange, knockbackResist, movementSpeed, attackDamage]: multipliers of the base (20 HP, 16 follow, 0.1 KB, 0.065 speed, 2 damage), ADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE, summed over all five slots; arms count twice. Speed capped at 0.35, KB at 1.0.
conventions.attributes: flat ADD_VALUE modifiers, ids minecraft:generic.* (1.21.1 names). Part armour total capped at 20.
conventions.weight: 1-4 per part; the soul's potency caps the sum (Faint 6, Lesser 9, Common 12, Potent 16, Mighty 20, Legendary 20).
conventions.arm_traits: Run once per Minion unless the type says otherwise (the right arm runs it, or the left when only the left has it).
conventions.bones: Per part, the geo bones drawn for it. A plain name matches that bone and its numbered copies (leg -> leg1, leg_2); a name with * is a glob. Bones in no list are hidden.
conventions.ids: NecroMob id necromancy:orespawn/<mob>; part items necromancy:orespawn_<mob>_<part>. Registered only when OreSpawn is loaded.

hurt_by_water.rule: Any part with it makes the Minion sensitive to water (vanilla isSensitiveToWater: 1 damage per second when wet). One part or four, the damage is the same.

fire_proof.rule: Fire immunity when the torso and legs both have it (existing rule). Change: when the legs slot is empty, the torso alone counts, so a snake or fish torso can be fire-proof.

breathes_water.rule: New. The Minion never loses air underwater when its head or torso has it.

cactus_proof.rule: New, OreSpawn's signature immunity: ignores minecraft:cactus and minecraft:sweet_berry_bush damage.

reaps.rule: New. A killing blow from a Minion with this arm counts as a scythe kill: if the Minion's pack or its owner within 16 blocks holds a glass bottle, a Soul in a Jar is bottled for the owner.

floats.rule: New. Bobs on the water surface instead of swimming down; overrides SINKS.

trait_types.behaviour: Passive properties the Minion checks. Each flag's rule is in the top-level 'flags' table.
trait_types.covers: CLIMBER, SUNBURN, SUN_PROOF, WATER_HURTS, FIRE_PROOF, THINKER, HEAVY

trait_types.behaviour: After a successful melee hit, with probability chance (and off cooldown), target.addEffect(effect, duration, amplifier) sourced from the Minion. Vanilla rules decide stacking; undead targets ignore poison.
After a hit, with probability chance, target.igniteForSeconds(seconds). Does nothing to fire-immune targets or targets in water or rain.

After a hit, target.push(dir.x*h, v, dir.z*h) with dir the normalised horizontal Minion->target vector, all scaled by (1 - target knockback resistance). Vertical is doubled against players (the OreSpawn rule). Plays the head mob's hurt sound at pitch 0.8.

to_pack.desc: put the item in the Minion's pack instead of on the ground

trait_types.behaviour: Only against a Mob (never a player, never a named, tamed or owned mob). With probability chance, takes the first non-empty listed slot, damages it by max durability / 20 and drops it at the target's feet with no pickup delay for the Minion's owner (or into the pack when to_pack and the Minion has one; if the pack is full it drops). The mob's drop chance for that slot becomes 0 so the item is not duplicated.

Needs mobGriefing. With probability chance, places the block at the target's feet if that block is air or replaceable plants, and records it in a SavedData list; it is removed after lifetime ticks (also on chunk load if overdue). Never replaces a block entity or a block another trait placed.

After a hit, minion.heal(min(max_per_hit, fraction * damage dealt)). heal() is direct, so it works although Minions ignore Regeneration. Arm copies stack per arm (each arm heals for its own hit share).

target.desc: an entity type tag, or airborne | small | large | wounded

trait_types.behaviour: If the target matches, deal (multiplier - 1) * the Minion's attack damage as an extra hit. airborne = not on ground and not in water; small = bounding box width < 0.6; large = width * height > 4; wounded = below 50% health.

min_run.desc: blocks moved toward the target; 0 = first strike

window.desc: ticks the run must fit in

multiplier.desc: damage factor of the charged hit

trait_types.behaviour: The tick hook records distance closed on the target. If the Minion closed min_run blocks within window ticks (min_run 0: the Minion has not hit this target for cooldown ticks, an ambush), the next hit deals an extra (multiplier - 1) * attack damage and pushes the target back by knockback (0.35 up). Then cooldown.
trait_types.covers: RAM (= min_run 4, window 40, multiplier 1.5, knockback 1.2, cooldown 100)

trait_types.behaviour: Extra damage = min(max, per_ally * other Minions of the same owner within radius whose same part slot holds this trait).

spread.desc: radians of random aim error per projectile

damage.desc: part_bolt only; vanilla projectiles keep vanilla damage

item.desc: part_bolt look: rendered as this item

ignite.desc: part_bolt: seconds of fire on hit

explosion.desc: part_bolt: explosion power on impact, never breaks blocks, max 1.5

trait_types.behaviour: Under the combat gate and range checks, every cooldown ticks fires count projectiles at the target's eye height minus 0.3, each with spread. Head parts fire from the eyes, arms from shoulder height (once per Minion; with two arms the volley alternates hands), torsos from the centre. necromancy:part_bolt is one generic ThrowableItemProjectile (gravity 0.01, life 100 t) that renders 'item' and carries damage/effect/ignite/explosion, so OreSpawn's own laser, water, acid and ice balls supply the look without their hard-coded 16-100 damage. Fireballs never set blocks alight unless mobGriefing.

Under the combat gate, when on the ground and the target is between min_range and max_range: setDeltaMovement(dir * horizontal, vertical). Fall damage from the leap is cancelled (the landing within 40 t takes none).

min_distance.desc: to_target: only when farther than this

trait_types.behaviour: to_target: the BLINK rule (16 tries near the target, ender sounds, 40 t retry on failure). away_when_hurt: when hit by a projectile or indirect magic, with chance, randomTeleport within radius and cancel that hit (the enderman dodge). victim: after a melee hit, with chance, randomTeleport the target (a Mob or an enemy-listed player, never a boss or #c:bosses) within radius.

melee_only.desc: only when the direct attacker is the living attacker

trait_types.behaviour: When hurt by a living, non-friendly attacker, with chance apply the effect to that attacker. Plays a cue particle (squid ink for blindness, sneeze cloud for nausea).
When hurt in melee by a living non-friendly attacker, deal min(max, flat + fraction * amount) as thorns(minion) damage to it, and ignite it if ignite_seconds > 0. Never reflects reflected damage.
When hurt by a melee attacker, with chance, attacker.knockback(strength) away from the Minion, with the slime-jump sound.

types.desc: damage type ids, damage type tags (#...), or * for all

condition.desc: always | idle (no attack and no movement for 40 t) | in_water | below_half

trait_types.behaviour: Multiplies incoming damage whose type matches while the condition holds. Never applies to #minecraft:bypasses_invulnerability. Multiple filters multiply together; the total floor is 0.1 unless one filter is an immunity (0).

effects.desc: list of {effect,duration,amplifier} applied to the Minion

trait_types.behaviour: When a hit would leave the Minion below threshold * max health and the cooldown is clear: apply the effects to itself, heal heal_fraction * max health, multiply that hit by damage_multiplier.

condition.desc: always | in_water | in_rain | in_dark | in_sun | out_of_combat

trait_types.behaviour: Every interval ticks while the condition holds, minion.heal(amount). in_dark = block light and sky light both below 8.

breaks_blocks.desc: also needs mobGriefing and the config switch

trait_types.behaviour: The VOLATILE rule with this power. Charged (lightning-struck) Minions double it, up to 4.
Spawns an AreaEffectCloud owned by the Minion at its death position; the cloud skips friendlies (custom predicate). Undead Minions nearby are unaffected by poison anyway.

entity.desc: spawnling:<mob> or an ambient entity id

trait_types.behaviour: spawnling:<mob> creates a temporary Minion built from every part that mob has (missing slots stay empty), owned by the same master, stance Aggressive, sharing the summoner's target. Spawnlings never drop items, souls, organs or Remains, gain no veterancy, cannot summon, do not count toward the shrine cap, and turn to soul particles after lifetime or when the summoner dies. An ambient entity id (orespawn:butterfly) is spawned as-is and is cosmetic. combat = under the combat gate every cooldown; hurt = when damaged; death = once on death.

Every interval ticks applies the effect to each target in radius. enemies = hostile Mobs (Enemy), the Minion's target, and enemy-listed players, never friendlies, villagers or bosses; allies = the friendly set; owner = the owner only. For enemies the aura is suppressed while the Minion's stance is Passive.

Under the combat gate, every interval ticks adds normalize(minion - victim) * strength (vertical * 0.5) to each victim in radius that is not a boss and weighs less than the Minion (bounding box volume). Plays a fishing-reel sound.

The LAYS_EGGS rule: on a random timer between interval min and max, drops one weighted pick (count items) at the Minion's feet. Pauses while the Minion is sitting in a minecart or boat, and while it is a spawnling.

consume.desc: replace (bucket -> milk bucket) | damage (shears lose 1 durability) | none

trait_types.behaviour: The owner uses use_item on the Minion: if off cooldown, gives count results (replace: ItemUtils.createFilledResult; damage: drops the result and damages the tool). Otherwise PASS.

needs_order.desc: work = only under the Work order; hurt = whenever below max health and idle

trait_types.behaviour: A low-priority goal. Paths to the nearest matching block within radius of its post, breaks one block per interval (needs mobGriefing). harvest: the block's loot goes into the pack (Work order) like the Farmer job; eat: heal and replace. Never breaks blocks in claimed areas (FakePlayer break event) or within 3 blocks of a bed, chest or the altar.

steering.desc: saddle_direct (WASD like a horse) | brain_on_a_stick (pig style)

jump.desc: 0-1 horse jump bar strength, 0 = no jump bar

trait_types.behaviour: Makes the torso saddleable (NecroMob.saddleable). Water mounts move at full speed only in water and dismount nobody underwater (#minecraft:dismounts_underwater excluded). No true flight: a mount with gliding wings glides its rider down instead.

horizontal_boost.desc: forward speed added per tick while gliding

trait_types.behaviour: When the Minion holds at least 'needs' glide parts, is falling faster than fall_speed, is not in a fluid and not on a ladder: clamp deltaMovement.y to -fall_speed, add horizontal_boost along its body yaw (capped at 0.4 horizontal speed), and reset fall distance. The slowest fall_speed among the parts wins. Ridden Minions glide with their rider.

condition.desc: water_or_rain | dry | sunlight | daylight | night | hot_biome | cold_biome | in_lava | nether

trait_types.behaviour: While the condition holds: hurt(generic) by damage every interval, and/or apply ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL modifiers (factor - 1) with id necromancy:env/<mob>/<part>, removed when it stops. dry = not in water, rain or a bubble column; daylight = day and sky light >= 12; sunlight = the undead sunburn test.
trait_types.covers: MELTS, the WATER_HURTS damage tick, Night Crawler 'photophobic'

condition.desc: always | dark (local light below the level)

trait_types.behaviour: Keeps one minecraft:light block (with this level) in the air block at the Minion's eye position, moved every 10 ticks and removed when the Minion moves away, dies, unloads or sits. Never replaces anything but air; no mobGriefing check needed because it never changes a real block.

self_floor.desc: stop below this fraction of own health

trait_types.behaviour: When the owner is within 8 blocks, below owner_threshold of max health, and the Minion is above self_floor: every interval the Minion takes amount magic damage and the owner heals amount. Red heart particles flow from Minion to owner.

creatures.flavour: The tyrant's skull still roars: everything near it fights a little weaker.
A back full of spikes: whatever bites the torso bleeds for it.
The night hunter: a cheaper T-Rex for a Potent soul, sewn with fossil bone.
A frost-crested scavenger that hunts in twos and threes.
The river fisher: hooked claws and a snout made for things that swim.
The fastest legs in the book, and they pounce; better in a pack.
A serpent king: its venom bites, and its gaze nails the crowd to the floor.
The nine-tailed Nether fox: a fire-proof body that throws fire and hates rain.
Three horns and a plated back: it charges, and it doesn't stop to think.
A gentle long-neck: two riders on its back, and it browses the hedges to heal.
An armoured battering ram whose horns throw men over the treetops.
A desert climber that eats spiders, sun-warmed and cactus-proof.
The Lumberjack: give it the Work order and it fells trees into its pack.
Its cheek pouches still cough up the seeds it hoarded.
Long ears and longer legs: the cheapest fast legs there are.
Plague teeth on a small body that climbs the walls.
Still lays eggs, now and then a lucky foot. Nobody asks where from.
A sea-going raft of a torso with lungs to spare; slow and sad on land.
It moults armour-grade feathers and still pecks at termites.
The racing saddle: a kick that clears the road, and a back made for riding.
The most dangerous bird alive: dagger-clawed legs that hobble what they kick.
Bred in stone corridors: it walks through cave-ins that would bury anything else.
Born to fight in coloured hats; a horde of them hits harder together.
The Digger: spade claws that clear dirt, sand and gravel under the Work order.
Burps coal from the front, leaves treasure out the back, and gasses whoever hits it.
Bleeds itself into its master: a living blood bag stitched to your side.
A shelled drain-beak that drinks the life out of whatever it bites.
Fire-proof, saddled and fire-breathing, with wings to glide the drop; sewn with the breath that made it.
A hatchling's spark: the early fire-proof body, sewn long before you can afford its mother.
The young purple dragon: lit with flint and steel, quick to spit fire.
A river wyrm that spits water hard enough to slow a charge, and never drowns.
The Leonopteryx: the best gliding wings in the mod on a saddled, man-tossing body.
A sky-shark mount bred to hunt Krakens: its bite is worst on the biggest prey.
A night-pest dragonet with a hot bite, sluggish under the sun.
Pincers that pin, a stinger that poisons, and a brood that crawls out to help.
The desert's small change: a poison tail on an armoured back.
A horn that hurls things straight up, on a shell that shrugs off fire.
Scythe-arms that drink a little of every cut; the thorax still carries wings.
A swamp artillery bug: a spray of acid, then a pounce.
The heavy jumper: leaps the gap, lands hard, and hatches a spit bug to cover it.
A house-sized stinger: poison from the abdomen, gliding wings, and a terror of rain.
The Caterkiller's grown-up form: a fire-spitting moth that glides on great wings.
Webs its prey to the floor; when it finally dies, its body breaks open into butterflies.
A night crawler of the ceilings; it wilts when the sun comes up.
Four jaws that open on a first strike from nowhere.
It casts and reels: claws that drag the target in from eight blocks away.
A thumbnail of jelly with the worst sting in the sea; it must stay wet.
A burning pincushion of a torso: punch it and catch fire.
A black ant: the cheapest wall-climbing legs, and a tiny sturdy body.
A fire ant whose bite lights the wound.
Its bite paints the target in rainbow light for everyone to see.
It was always going to pop.
Heals by chewing planks; keep it out of the house.
Springs for legs: the best jump in the book, and barely any body.
Dies in a poison cloud that your undead Minions breathe like perfume.
Four wings that glide far, on a body that hunts anything smaller than itself.
A proboscis that sips back a little blood with every bite.
Paper-thin wings with the slowest fall in the book: pure gliding, no fight.
Pale night wings and feathered antennae that find prey in the dark.
A blood-drinking head that weakens its prey and burns in the sun.
A walking lantern: its torso lights the cave around it.
The pest of every cliff road; its wings at least carry you down from one.
A songbird's wings: a better chicken, sewn from bird seed.
It still lays a ruby every few days, as it did in life.
Rubber all the way through: no blood, no drowning, and it floats.
A sticky tongue that reels in bugs, on legs that swim and spring.
Pinned wings that still shed light and let the body drift down slowly.
A finned sea serpent that heals in water and flounders on land.
The sea's own basilisk: fangs dripping Poison II, deadly in water and slow out of it.
A squid that learned to shoot back: water balls, and now and then a blinding ink shot.
Shell plates and two claws that fling whatever they pinch.
A ray's flat body: the best swimmer for its price, gasping out of water.
Flat enough that arrows slide off it, as long as it stays wet.
A fish that swims in the sky; its body still won't fall properly.
A shark that swims the clouds: it bites fliers out of the air.
It rips the boots off whatever it bites.
A bigger mouth that strips greaves as well as boots.
The great worm disarms knights and births little worms as it goes.
A hedge that waits: its first blow from cover lands hard.
A shell that clams shut when idle, a snapping venomous head, and roots that will not be moved.
Something from the WTF dungeon: a self-mending torso and legs that leap.
An armoured enderman: it blinks in, dodges arrows, and its blade throws you somewhere else.
A reaper's arms that reap: its kills bottle souls for you, as a scythe's would.
The Burglar's light fingers: they lift a mob's weapon straight into the Minion's pack.
A spider that wears armour and is used to being in the driver's seat.
The wind-up Bomb-Omb: a cheap bomb torso that goes off when the Minion falls.
The Robo-Pounder: golem-grade plating and fists that slam targets into the air.
The Robo-Gunner: arm cannons that fire laser balls every few seconds.
The Robo-Warrior: a shielded chest that halves arrows, and a swat that sends foes flying.
The Robo-Sniper's turret and wheels: fast on the flat, can't climb a step, shoots from thirty blocks.
Jeffery's laser-eye head and wrecking-ball fists, salvaged from a ten-block robot.
The Apple Cow: milk from the udder, an apple now and then from somewhere else.
The Orchard Cow: shear the blossom off its back for apples.
From the Crystal dimension: it grows crystal apples.
The original Golden Apple Cow: one golden apple every two or three days.
The Golden Orchard Cow: shear a golden apple off it once every two days.
The glinting cow: every five minutes its master gains a shell of Absorption.

excluded.reason: Mobzilla: 4000 HP, 25 blocks tall. Its soul is the prize; no part fits a Minion frame.
1000+ HP flying squid boss with grab-and-carry. Legendary soul only.
7000 HP three-headed final boss. Legendary soul only.
6000 HP three-headed boss. Legendary soul only.

Royal hatchling (500 HP) that appears when the King dies and hatches from Prince eggs. Soul only, and only Mighty (by health, not the Legendary tag), so one boss kill cannot pay out two Legendary souls.
Royal hatchling (400 HP) that appears when the Queen dies. Soul only, Mighty by health.
1500 HP royal mount. Legendary soul only.
3000 HP royal mount that grows into The King. Legendary soul only.
The WTF-dungeon's single capped summoner (320 HP). A dungeon boss: Legendary soul; the plain Alien gives the parts.
The Nightmare: Danger Dimension apex with a boss bar, 125-1000 HP by size tier. Legendary soul only.
Boss bar, multipart hitbox and a Nether Star drop. Legendary soul; the Brutalfly gives moth wings.
Invisible hitbox sidecar of The King. Not a creature: it must never yield a soul (6000 HP would read as Mighty).
Hitbox sidecar of The Queen. No soul, no parts.
Hitbox sidecar of Mobzilla. No soul, no parts.
A spinning loot pinata, not a creature.
A floating island block-entity with a health bar.
The second floating island.
The Hoverboard vehicle.
A rock you pick up.
A T-shirt statue that drops leather.
An energy bomb the King and Queen throw; it has health only so it can be shot down.
A rideable mech built from a kit; a vehicle, not a body.
A rideable mech built from a kit; a vehicle, not a body. (The Spider Driver gives parts.)
A spirit with no flesh to stitch. It still yields a Faint soul.
A ghost in chains; incorporeal, soul only.
A living whirlwind: no head, no torso, one bone in its model. Soul only.
A crystal gyroscope of spinning blades; nothing that could be sewn. Soul only.
A named companion NPC. The Villager already covers human parts, and stitching your partner is past the tone. Soul only.
As the Girlfriend. Soul only.
